2840.title: Provider session identities are absent from thread search
2840.rootCauseOneLine: Event writes store the provider identity but only add message text to the index that native search queries.
2840.proposedFix: Persist indexed provider identities, backfill them from events, and merge exact or prefix identity matches with text results.
2840.caveats: The focused test covered one active identity. Replacement identities and archive behavior were not tested.
